name: spellkave_acting_context
label: Spellkave Acting Context
description: List or explicitly select your current character or caller-owned presence binding for this session. Selection is revalidated on every call; revoked and foreign bindings refuse. Select one of the listed binding ids when a privileged act is ambiguous. This does not grant roles or transfer NPC consent.

binding_id.description: Select a currently caller-owned presence binding. Omit to list your contexts.

character.description: Select your primary character. Mutually exclusive with binding_id.
